The other shelf isn't a shelf at all — it's the floor the whole shop stands on. You don't charge different prices for the floor; everyone walks on it, because it's what makes the shop a shop. The builder moved the rope, relabeled the floor, and checked that no trace of the old labels remained anywhere — not one leftover word.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine a magic box that tidies itself. And the ledger — the big book where every action is written down — isn't something you buy more of. It's just there, for everyone, because it's how the whole place stays honest. The builder erased the old prices from that row so thoroughly that not one old word is left anywhere on the page.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, some things are measured and some things are the ground you stand on.
